newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Portugal's new U.N. envoy presents credentials.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's new U.N. envoy presents credentials.

text.p: Portugal's new U.N. ambassador, Antonio Victor Martins Monteiro, presented his credentials on Friday to Secretary-General Kofi Annan, the first envoy to do so since the Ghanaian diplomat took up his post as U.N. chief on January 1.
Portugal began a two-year term on the 15-nation Security Council at the beginning of the year. Under the council's system of monthly rotation, Monteiro is due to serve as its president during April.
Monteiro, 52, has been elected chairman of the council committee which oversees sanctions imposed on Iraq since its 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
